runErrors.run_failed: The run failed. The details are in the app log.

tableSources.runWarning: Objects not evaluated: {{count}}. The rule reads fields from {{sources}}, which could not be read ({{reasons}}). They are not counted as passed or failed, nor in the score.
tableSources.notEvaluated: Not evaluated: {{fields}} could not be read from {{sources}} ({{reason}}).

reasons.no_access: no access to the system table
reasons.timed_out: the query was still running at the time limit
reasons.budget_exceeded: the run reached its limit of statements on the SQL warehouse
reasons.transient: the SQL warehouse was temporarily unavailable, also after retries
reasons.not_found: the system table was not found (is the system schema enabled?)
reasons.not_loaded: tags are not read for this type of object yet

runScoreCoverage.coverage: {{evaluated}} of {{total}} objects evaluated; the others are not in the score.
runScoreCoverage.hiddenResults: {{count}} results are on Unity Catalog objects you can't read, so they are not listed.

saveErrors.rule_trailing_input: The rule has input that is not valid, starting at line {{line}}, column {{column}} ('{{text}}'). Everything from there on would be ignored, so the rule would check less than it says. Remove it or fix the syntax.
saveErrors.notify_target_not_allowed: This policy may not notify '{{target}}'. Admins can notify anyone. Others can notify themselves, the entity's owners and the notification recipients their roles allow.
saveErrors.notify_recipient_not_allowed: Your roles may not use the notification recipient '{{recipient}}'
saveErrors.notify_recipient_not_found: The notification recipient '{{recipient}}' does not exist
saveErrors.llm_check_criterion_not_literal: LLM_CHECK takes a text and a criterion written as a string literal, for example LLM_CHECK(t.comment, 'states the grain of the table').

runWarnings.rule_trailing_input: This rule has input that is not valid, starting at line {{line}}, column {{column}} ('{{text}}'). It is ignored when the rule runs, so the rule may check less than it says. Edit the rule to fix it.
runWarnings.notifications_failed: The policy's notifications (NOTIFY) could not be sent for this run. The results are complete.
runWarnings.llm_check_budget_exceeded: {{count}} LLM checks were not run because the run reached its budget of {{budget}} model calls, so those entities failed. Run it again (cached verdicts don't count) or raise COMPLIANCE_LLM_CHECK_MAX_CALLS_PER_RUN.
runWarnings.llm_check_daily_quota_exceeded: {{count}} LLM checks were not run because you used your {{limit}} model calls for today, so those entities failed. Run it again tomorrow (cached verdicts don't count) or ask an admin to raise COMPLIANCE_LLM_CHECK_MAX_CALLS_PER_USER_PER_DAY.
runWarnings.no_entities_matched: No entities matched this rule, so nothing was checked. If you expected some, check its MATCH type and WHERE condition.

test.failed: The rule could not be tested.
test.noChecks: No LLM_CHECK was evaluated for this entity.

codes.llm_check_not_available: LLM_CHECK is only evaluated in compliance runs, in ASSERT.
codes.llm_check_disabled: The LLM features are turned off, so LLM_CHECK fails.
codes.llm_check_no_endpoint: No serving endpoint is configured, so LLM_CHECK fails.
codes.llm_check_budget_exceeded: Not checked: the run reached its budget of model calls.
codes.llm_check_text_too_long: Not checked: the text is too long.
codes.llm_check_call_failed: The serving endpoint could not be called.
codes.llm_check_refused: The model refused to judge the text.
codes.llm_check_truncated: The model's reply did not finish.
codes.llm_check_invalid_reply: The model's reply was not a PASS or FAIL verdict.
codes.llm_check_text_too_short: Not checked: the text is too short to judge.
codes.rule_evaluation_failed: The rule could not be evaluated on this entity.
codes.llm_check_text_rejected: Not checked: the safety check flagged the text (for example, instructions to the model).
codes.llm_check_daily_quota_exceeded: Not checked: you used your model calls for today.
codes.llm_check_external_endpoint: Not checked: LLM_BASE_URL points outside this Databricks workspace, and LLM_CHECK only sends entity text to the workspace's serving endpoints.

errors.sample_entity_not_found: No entity the rule matches was found. Check the name, or leave it empty to use the first match.
errors.llm_check_test_rate_limited: Too many tests in a short time. Try again in {{retryAfter}} seconds.
errors.llm_check_entity_read_required: This rule uses LLM_CHECK on {{entityType}} entities. Running or testing it needs read access to them.
errors.llm_check_admin_required: This rule uses LLM_CHECK. Saving, running or testing it requires admin access to compliance.
errors.llm_check_tag_action: A rule with LLM_CHECK can't use ASSIGN_TAG or REMOVE_TAG ({{actions}}): the model's verdict would change tags. Use NOTIFY, or a separate rule without LLM_CHECK for the tag actions.
errors.llm_check_daily_quota_exceeded: You used your {{limit}} LLM_CHECK model calls for today. Try again in {{retryAfter}} seconds (the count starts over at midnight UTC).
errors.llm_check_policy_in_use: This policy is used by {{workflowSteps}} workflow policy checks and {{maturityGates}} maturity gates. They can't evaluate LLM_CHECK, so it would fail every entity there. Remove the policy from them first, or use LLM_CHECK in a separate policy.
errors.llm_check_policy_in_self_service: This policy is in the self-service compliance mapping for {{objectTypes}}. Self-service can't evaluate LLM_CHECK, so it would refuse every object there. Remove the policy from the mapping first, or use LLM_CHECK in a separate policy.
errors.llm_check_in_where: LLM_CHECK is only evaluated in ASSERT. In WHERE it fails, so the rule skips every entity. Move it to ASSERT.

llmCheck.usage: LLM_CHECK: {{calls}} model calls, {{cached}} verdicts from the cache.
llmCheck.notEvaluatedCount: Not evaluated: {{count}} (an LLM_CHECK could not run; not counted as failed or in the score).
